title: Synaptic Classification via Spike-Triggered Extrapolation
summary: This work introduces a statistical procedure to infer the interaction graph of neuronal networks modeled by Galves-Löcherbach dynamics. The methodology performs bivariate inference, identifying synaptic links from the spike trains of pairs of neurons without observing the rest of the network. We propose a Macro-Micro Extrapolation algorithm to address data sparsity by inferring interactions in the limit $Δ\to 0^+$.
